paper_v7_authorization.interpretation: 100% is a hard ceiling, not a target. Kelly, executable depth, authoritative fees, spread/slippage, joint completion, partial/unwind loss, adverse markout, capital/latency costs, reconciliation/state integrity and the 15% drawdown kill switch still bind.

architecture.target: one slim canonical V7 PAPER codebase
architecture.no_champion_interpretation: Temporary recovery state caused by premature legacy retirement; it is not a successful V7 cutover and grants no deployment authority.
architecture.legacy_rule: Do not add new logic to or restore V3/V4/V5/V6 wholesale. If premature cleanup removed a primitive required by V7, recover its behavior from Git history into V7/common/control-plane, add equivalent tests, migrate callers, then keep legacy deleted.

economic_objective.multi_leg_rule: Estimate the empirical joint completion/state distribution; product or minimum of marginal fill probabilities is not an accepted substitute.
economic_objective.success: positive forward realized PAPER fill-conditioned post-cost PnL with causal data, actual simulated fills, authoritative fees, executable depth, partial/unwind losses, adverse markout, cost stress and no leakage

model_contracts.fast_structural_arb: first economic frontier; event-driven/local L2 where possible, exchange/receive/decision clocks, stale and sequence-continuity checks, authoritative per-market fees, executable depth, sequential leg revalidation, latency, partial/unwind and realized PAPER PnL
model_contracts.graph_rv: queue ahead reduces fillability and must never grant capital; estimate empirical joint completion and compare maker/maker, maker/taker, taker/maker, taker/taker, sequential, near-simultaneous, join, improve and cross by total executable EV
model_contracts.cross_sectional_ranking: relative top-vs-bottom ranking; evaluate 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h and 6h separately; frozen holdout is fit once strictly before holdout_start minus embargo and never refit inside holdout; adaptive walk-forward evidence is separate
model_contracts.micro_taker: selective complete executable round-trip target after spread, authoritative entry/exit fees, depth/slippage, uncertainty, adverse move and capital-time cost; open positions mark to full-depth executable liquidation net of exit fee or fail closed
model_contracts.external_intelligence: run in parallel; inspect existing implementation and portfolio workspace read-only first; all features/probability mappings must be point-in-time with provenance and stale-data rejection
model_contracts.learned_execution: estimate P(fill|X,a), fill-conditioned markout and multi-leg joint state distributions empirically for join/improve/fade/cross/size/timeout/cancel/replace and expose them to all strategies
model_contracts.micro_maker: selective incentive-aware maker only; report trading PnL and rewards separately; unconditional always-improve is not alpha
model_contracts.pca: single-leg residual statistical arbitrage only; evaluate 30m, 1h, 2h and 6h separately; no mandatory hedge basket or terminal-probability semantics
model_contracts.local_factor: pair-specific panels, pair-excluded orientation-invariant factor basis, same-basis null-preserving inference, dependence-robust multiplicity, horizon-matched forecasts and explicit execution economics

rules: keep state, PnL, labels and inference separate by frequency
do not select a new frequency post hoc on the same holdout
new frequencies require prospective chronological evidence
frozen holdout evidence and adaptive walk-forward evidence must never be mixed
